### Enjoying Good Things
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-november-18-2024.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:17
Points:
- Believers often wrestle with false guilt or fear regarding desires for nice things.
- Material possessions become spiritually dangerous only when they take control of our hearts.
- True security rests in God rather than the unreliability of earthly wealth.
- God is a gracious provider who supplies good things for our genuine enjoyment.
- We should enjoy blessings with gratitude while reserving our worship for the Giver alone.

### Enjoying God
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-august-3-2022.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:17
Points:
- Faith and spiritual gifts should not be boxed away and kept out of everyday life.
- God desires for His people to experience joy, merriment, and delight in His presence.
- We are called to place our hope in God rather than uncertain earthly riches.
- The Lord generously provides good things for us to actively use and enjoy.
- Receiving and enjoying God's gifts brings pleasure back to the Giver.
